findings.claim: `DepthStep` changed from `>=` to `>`, an off-by-one that admits one more nesting level than `MaximumObjectGraphDepth`. With the default `UntrustedData` limit of 500, a 501-deep graph is now accepted. A configured limit of N now allows N+1 levels, and a limit of 0 now allows one level. This weakens the stack-depth protection described in L9. It is unrelated to REQ-2234 (analyzer behaviour with `SuppressSourceGeneration`), and the acceptance criteria require unrelated behaviour to stay unchanged.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.SecurityDepthStepOffByOneTests. With `MaximumObjectGraphDepth = 1` and `reader.Depth = 1`, `DepthStep` throws `InsufficientExecutionStackException` on base but not on head. With limit 0 and depth 0 it also throws on base only.
